catalogue.name: Rookie Adventurer
catalogue.desc: A new adventurer takes modest jobs beyond the village gates, learning the roads and earning their first hard-won credits.

catalogue.name: Campfire Scavengers
catalogue.desc: At first light, scavengers search abandoned camps for forgotten tools, supplies and treasures worth another journey.

catalogue.name: Copper Mining Crew
catalogue.desc: Lantern-lit miners follow copper veins through the foothills, hauling ore back to the settlement after every shift.

catalogue.name: Village Outpost
catalogue.desc: A timber watchtower anchors a lively frontier outpost, where guards and merchants keep the roads open.

catalogue.name: Goblin Patrol
catalogue.desc: Goblin scouts patrol with great confidence and approximately zero sense of direction. Their reports are mostly doodles.

catalogue.name: Quest Board
catalogue.desc: Wax-sealed notices draw travelers from every tavern. Each completed contract brings another tale to the board.

catalogue.name: Runesmith Workshop
catalogue.desc: Rune-carvers work by enchanted coals, engraving protective sigils onto travelers' weapons and tools.

catalogue.name: Merchant Caravan
catalogue.desc: Pack beasts and seasoned traders cross dangerous routes, carrying rare goods between distant settlements.

catalogue.name: Forest Rangers
catalogue.desc: Hidden among ancient pines, the rangers patrol forgotten trails and guide wanderers out of the deep forest.

catalogue.name: Ancient Ruins Expedition
catalogue.desc: Torch-bearing scholars descend into vine-covered temples, piecing together maps of kingdoms swallowed by time.

catalogue.name: Alchemy Circle
catalogue.desc: Alchemists gather around bubbling flasks, refining unstable reagents into tinctures sought across the realm.

catalogue.name: Dwarven Foundry
catalogue.desc: Deep beneath the mountains, dwarven smiths hammer glowing ingots on anvils that have never gone cold.

catalogue.name: Moonlit Library
catalogue.desc: By pale moonlight, archivists translate enchanted manuscripts that whisper their secrets only after dusk.

catalogue.name: Dragon Hatchery
catalogue.desc: Careful handlers tend smoldering nests where young dragons learn to fly without setting the roof on fire.

catalogue.name: Dungeon Delvers
catalogue.desc: Hardened explorers descend beneath ruined keeps with ropes, rations and an unreasonable amount of optimism.

catalogue.name: Crystal Caverns
catalogue.desc: Miners harvest luminous crystals from caverns where every footstep rings like a distant bell.

catalogue.name: Starfall Observatory
catalogue.desc: Astronomers track falling stars and chart celestial omens from a lonely tower above the clouds.

catalogue.name: Void Researchers
catalogue.desc: Scholars probe tears in the void, cataloguing what comes through and ensuring the door opens only one way.

catalogue.name: Celestial Armory
catalogue.desc: Master armorers temper starlit metals beneath constellations, forging weapons that shimmer with the night sky.

catalogue.name: Arcane Citadel
catalogue.desc: High above the valley, an arcane citadel channels ley-line energy through its spiraling towers.

catalogue.name: Abyss Watchers
catalogue.desc: Silent sentinels guard the abyssal frontier, watching for creatures that move between the shadows.

catalogue.name: Stormguard Keep
catalogue.desc: Stormguard defenders hold the mountain keep as thunder crashes against its lightning-struck battlements.

catalogue.name: Titan Excavators
catalogue.desc: Colossal excavators carve through ancient stone, uncovering buried machinery from an age of giants.

catalogue.name: Forgotten Gateway
catalogue.desc: A sealed archway stirs in the wilderness. Explorers study its runes for clues to the realm beyond.

catalogue.name: Mythic Forge
catalogue.desc: Master smiths weave rare ore and captured starfire into relics fit for legendary champions.

catalogue.name: Dungeon Nexus
catalogue.desc: The Dungeon Nexus binds distant labyrinths together, sending explorers toward doors that never appear twice.

catalogue.name: Soulbound Atelier
catalogue.desc: Soulbound artisans shape enchanted artifacts, each carrying an echo of the spirit that forged it.

catalogue.name: Astral Rift Explorers
catalogue.desc: Riftwalkers navigate constellations torn apart by astral storms, returning with fragments of impossible worlds.

catalogue.name: Sky Fortress
catalogue.desc: A fortress rides the upper winds, its watchtowers keeping vigil over lands far below the clouds.

catalogue.name: Dragon Dominion
catalogue.desc: Dragon lords govern volcanic territories where wingbeats shake valleys and treasure caravans never travel alone.

catalogue.name: Silverguard Legion
catalogue.desc: The Silverguard Legion marches beneath polished banners, holding the line against threats from forgotten kingdoms.

catalogue.name: Arcane Council
catalogue.desc: The Arcane Council debates the laws of magic behind sealed doors. Their latest motion: more meetings about fewer meetings.

catalogue.name: Sunstone Kingdom
catalogue.desc: Sunstone monarchs gather light into golden halls, sustaining a realm that glows through the longest winter.

catalogue.name: Chrono Sanctuary
catalogue.desc: Chronomancers preserve moments inside a hidden sanctuary, keeping lost histories from slipping out of time.

catalogue.name: Elysian Vault
catalogue.desc: The Elysian Vault protects treasures so ancient that even its guardians have forgotten what some keys unlock.

catalogue.name: Rune Singularity
catalogue.desc: Runes converge into a brilliant singularity, concentrating raw magic until ordinary measures lose all meaning.

catalogue.name: Ember Sovereigns
catalogue.desc: Ember-crowned sovereigns rule a sea of fire, shaping molten rivers into engines of ancient power.

catalogue.name: Elder Titans
catalogue.desc: Elder Titans awaken beneath the mountains, lending their colossal strength to reshape entire landscapes.

catalogue.name: Nightmare Foundry
catalogue.desc: The Nightmare Foundry smelts fear into blackened steel. Its workers swear the furnace sometimes knows their names.

catalogue.name: Celestial Realm
catalogue.desc: Within the Celestial Realm, radiant cities drift through the heavens on currents of pure magic.

catalogue.name: Eternal Throne
catalogue.desc: An eternal throne commands armies across the ages, its court unchanged while empires rise and fall.

catalogue.name: Infinite Labyrinth
catalogue.desc: The Infinite Labyrinth rearranges itself after every expedition. The cartographers have stopped asking for refunds.

catalogue.name: Worldseed Nexus
catalogue.desc: At the Worldseed Nexus, ancient roots connect distant realities, nurturing new lands from fragments of creation.

catalogue.name: Elemental Empire
catalogue.desc: The Elemental Empire commands fire, frost, stone and storm through a network of living citadels.

catalogue.name: Fabled Pantheon
catalogue.desc: The Fabled Pantheon lends divine favor to champions whose names are etched into the skies.

catalogue.name: Quantum Legion
catalogue.desc: Quantum soldiers occupy several battlefronts at once. Their commander asks everyone to stop being both present and absent.

catalogue.name: Primal Nebula
catalogue.desc: A primal nebula breathes new stars into existence, feeding distant worlds with the first sparks of light.

catalogue.name: Timekeeper's Gate
catalogue.desc: Gatekeepers guard every century. Your request will be handled in five minutes, but they won't say which timeline.

catalogue.name: Forbidden Archive
catalogue.desc: Forbidden archivists study names erased from history, locking dangerous knowledge behind silent wards.

catalogue.name: Phoenix Ascendant
catalogue.desc: A phoenix rises above the ashes of fallen empires, its flame reigniting forgotten roads and ruined cities.

catalogue.name: Grand ARVEE Citadel
catalogue.desc: The Grand ARVEE Citadel unites far-flung strongholds, drawing wealth and knowledge into its towering heart.

catalogue.name: Immortal Dynasty
catalogue.desc: An immortal dynasty passes its crown through endless generations, ruling with wisdom older than recorded history.

catalogue.name: Realmforge Engine
catalogue.desc: The Realmforge Engine reshapes raw existence into whole continents, leaving stardust in the gears.

catalogue.name: Cosmic Arbiter
catalogue.desc: A cosmic arbiter weighs the fate of worlds, settling disputes with laws written into the stars.

catalogue.name: Genesis Architects
catalogue.desc: Genesis Architects draft blueprints for newborn realities, placing oceans and constellations with a careful hand.

catalogue.name: ARVEE Core
catalogue.desc: At the heart of everything, ARVEE Core keeps the realms running. Someone found the 'numbers go up' lever. Nobody dared turn it off.
